subject: Renewal: sequencing for uplift + addendum / clarifying MSA redlines
messages:
From: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@lighthouse.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.inference>
Cc: Mark Donovan <m.donovan@lighthouse.ai>, procurement@lighthouse.ai
Date: Tue, 26 Sep 2028 09:15:00 -0500
Subject: Renewal sequencing question + uplift order form

Hi Mateo —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to move forward with the 18-month renewal and a 35% capacity uplift (projected start 10/15). Before procurement issues a PO I need to clarify sequencing between: (a) the Order Form for the capacity bump, (b) an addendum that reflects the new monthly committed units, and (c) a couple of targeted MSA redlines from our legal team (retention + audit rights).

Specific asks:
- Can Redwood accept signing the Order Form first and follow with a limited addendum that updates the coverage schedule?
- If legal redlines are required to be agreed before signature, can you share a proposed path/timeline?
- Any dependencies from your side for DocuSign / procurement?

We have budget approval for October, but procurement wants the DocuSign packet no later than 10/02 to hit their cutoff. Attaching our internal milestone memo.

Best,
Elena
Director, Cloud Procurement
Lighthouse Analytics

Attachment: LHA_budget_memo_2028Q4.pdf (pdf)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@lighthouse.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 26 Sep 2028 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Renewal sequencing question + uplift order form

Elena —

Appreciate the clear asks. Short answer: yes, we can typically sign the Order Form to lock the capacity/price and then execute an addendum that updates the MSA coverage schedule and exhibit references. That is our preferred path for speed, but there are two caveats where legal may require alignment before signature: data retention limits and any change to the audit / access rights.

Looping in Karthik (legal) and Laura (sales ops) to confirm the exact gating items. Proposed sequencing I recommend:
1) Finalize Order Form (price, term, committed units) — get signature via DocuSign by 10/02.
2) Concurrently exchange redlines for the MSA addendum (we can agree on language within a week and attach the addendum to the signed order form as an amendment).
3) If legal requires it, we can include a conditional statement in the Order Form: signature acknowledges order form subject to final MSA addendum language, but billing/seat activation will not commence until the addendum is mutually executed.

Laura — can you prepare a DocuSign envelope for the Order Form draft (v3) and a short checklist for procurement? Karthik — any immediate 'deal blockers' in the requested retention/audit asks that would force us to delay signature?

Mateo
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachment: R-INFU-sequencing-playbook.pdf (pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
Cc: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@lighthouse.ai>
Date: Tue, 26 Sep 2028 14:28:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Renewal sequencing question + uplift order form

Thanks for pulling this together. High level from legal — we can support the Order Form-first flow provided we address the following with either explicit language in the Order Form or an agreed addendum within a short window:

Key redline items I see from the customer's initial note:
- Data retention: customer requests a 5-year retention carve-out for audit logs. Our standard retention is 1 year for logs; 5 years is non-standard and has storage/privacy implications. Proposed compromise: we offer exportable audit logs and a 3-year retention for audit-related artifacts; include exact scoping (which logs, export format, delivery SLA).
- Audit & access: customer wants on-site audit rights and unfettered access. We can provide SOC2-type evidence and remote audit support; on-site audits require pre-notification and limited scope — propose language to permit audits subject to Redwood's security and confidentiality constraints, and reasonable notice (30 days) with mutually agreed scope.
- SLA credits: with the uplift we should preserve our standard SLA language; customer proposed additional credits for scheduled maintenance windows — we should accept a small maintenance credit but not expand to blanket credits for capacity usage.

Action items for us:
- I'll produce a redline excerpt of the MSA with proposed language for the three bullets above (see attached PDF).
- Laura, please prepare the Order Form with a conditional start clause: "Activation subject to execution of Addendum A (MSA Exhibit update) within 21 days" — this gives legal runway without blocking procurement.

If the customer insists on a 5-year retention spelled into the core MSA before any signature, we will need executive approval due to potential compliance cost.

-Karthik
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: MSA_excerpt_retention_clause_redline.pdf (pdf)

From: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@lighthouse.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.inference>
Cc: Mark Donovan <m.donovan@lighthouse.ai>, procurement@lighthouse.ai, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 27 Sep 2028 08:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Renewal sequencing question + uplift order form

Thanks Mateo / Karthik / Laura — helpful clarity. Procurement's position: they need a DocuSign packet by 10/02 with an executed Order Form in order to release funds. They're fine with an addendum post-signature if we have a clear mutual action plan and the conditional start language you suggested.

Our ask back to Redwood legal: can you accept 3 years retention with a one-time paid archival option to reach 5 years (we have an internal compliance rationale)? If so, procurement says that is enough for sign-off. Also appreciate the restricted on-site audit language — we'll accept 30 days notice and remote-first with limited scope.

Next steps from our side:
- We'll review Karthik's redline and confirm by 09/28 EOD.
- Procurement requests the DocuSign link for the Order Form draft (v3) so we can route it through our internal approvers.

Elena

Attachment: LHA_procurement_checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@lighthouse.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 29 Sep 2028 14:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal sequencing question + uplift order form

Elena / team —

Great — thanks for the quick turn. Summary & agreed plan:
1) Order Form v3 attached to DocuSign envelope and routed to Lighthouse by 10/02. Laura will send the envelope this afternoon.
2) Order Form will include conditional activation language: "Activation subject to execution of Addendum A within 21 days of Order Form signature."
3) Legal compromise: Redwood accepts 3-year retention by default; Lighthouse may purchase one-time archival service to reach 5 years (we'll include pricing in the addendum). Remote audit-first approach with 30 days notice accepted.
4) Karthik will finalize the two redline snippets and Laura will include the addendum stub in the DocuSign packet for signature acknowledgement.

Action owners / deadlines:
- Laura Bennett: prepare DocuSign envelope + Order Form v3 (due 2028-09-29 EOD) — Laura to share link to procurement.
- Karthik Iyer: finalize redline PDF and addendum language (due 2028-10-03).
- Elena / Mark (Lighthouse): confirm redlines by 2028-09-28 EOD and route DocuSign internally.

DocuSign link (placeholder): https://docusign.example.com/packet/LD-2028-0421

I'll follow up once the envelope is sent. Thanks everyone — this sequencing should let us meet procurement timelines without exposing us to unreviewed long-term retention commitments.

Cheers,
Mateo
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachments: LHA_OrderForm_v3_redlines.docx (docx)
